name: eval_v2
description: Held-out test set for matcher v3. Written and frozen before any matcher-v3 code, never used for tuning. Targets evidence combined across lines: skills listed in one line and a strong verb on unrelated work in another. Synthetic: all people, companies and projects are invented. Labels drafted by an AI assistant.

requirements.text: Build ETL pipelines with Airflow or Dagster
Write SQL in Snowflake or BigQuery
Build dashboards in Looker or Tableau for business teams
Deploy pipelines on AWS or GCP
Communicate data issues to non-technical stakeholders
Familiarity with Kafka or streaming systems
Train and evaluate ML models with PyTorch or scikit-learn
Deploy models with Docker and Kubernetes
Build REST APIs for model serving
Own model monitoring and drift detection
Experience with MLflow or Weights & Biases
